key_findings.finding: The aryl Grignard reagent undergoes Pd-catalyzed Kumada coupling at the aryl triflate site: the aryl C–O(triflate) bond is replaced by a C–C bond to the Grignard aryl carbon. The coupled aryl group is the 2-methoxyphenyl group from COc1cccc([Mg+])c1.
